entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that functions as a universal memory layer with multi-level support for User, Session, and Agent states. It offers temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval through an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud SDK.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system enables agents to learn through long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows across more than 25 LLM providers. It provides flexible deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud with client libraries for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and tiered loading to achieve significant token reduction. It archives sessions as editable Markdown files and operates under the AGPL-3.0 license.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform provides agents with persistent long-term memory by building searchable knowledge graphs from text, code, and conversation data. It runs locally on CPU without requiring LLM API keys and supports custom ontologies for structured memory.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine that sustains sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It utilizes byte-level deduplication for prompt-cache discounts and supports multi-modal extraction from PDFs, images, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain stores facts with provenance to support corrections and withdrawals while providing a synthesis layer for cited answers. It exposes memory to agents via MCP over Tailscale or local connections to facilitate gap analysis.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that serves as the upstream foundation for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It is implemented as a FastAPI server and integrates with MCP, Claude Code, and Cursor-compatible clients.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It employs a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based to ensure sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that requires only Python 3.10 and a single SQLite database for sub-millisecond operations. It features episodic compression to manage storage growth and supports integrations with MCP and OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent vector search and structured facts. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected contexts within an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness designed to help agents succeed on complex tasks by generating playbooks and local-model training artifacts. It supports various endpoints including vLLM and Ollama via CLI, MCP server, or Pi extensions.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent that uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to recover specific details from the message persistence layer.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes session history from 35 different coding agents to provide shared cross-tool memory without using models or external servers. It allows users to search months of past sessions by tracking file edits, command exit statuses, and specific session spans locally.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for Hermes Agent to enable private, cross-session memory persistence. It includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer offers portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients, achieving 97.6% accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks. It supports real-time data ingestion from sources like Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub to maintain agent context.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur utilizes a human-readable YAML 'engram' format to store shared memory on a local disk for multi-agent systems. It facilitates shared context across various coding agents using local-first retrieval methods, including BGE-small and optional rerankers.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It fuses BM25, vector search, and multi-graph traversal to capture agent decisions and preferences directly from session transcripts.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This plugin family provides durable, file-based long-term memory using a SQLite-backed five-tier hierarchical schema and FTS5 search. It is distinguished by a zero vector database and zero embedding model architecture, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context LLM inference for Hermes Agent through text and multimodal context reordering. It provides a context index for deduplication and cache-aware scheduling to accelerate inference while preserving accuracy.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded, in-process backend provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled memory with a 'why_retrieved' explanation. It manages memory health by surfacing contradictions through conflict primitives and applying recency ranking.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses a user's Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search, ensuring memory remains daemonless and transparent.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This proactive memory CLI allows agents to autonomously maintain and evolve persistent knowledge stored in local SQLite and Wiki files. It also supports team synchronization via a self-hosted server with granular permission controls.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd implements anticipatory memory by watching agent session logs to prefetch context into a local-first SQLite-vec cache. Built as an MCP-native server, it uses GGUF models via node-llama-cpp to manage retrieval for coding agents.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel for Hermes Agent by integrating Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single stack. It utilizes SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver a purpose-built evidence packet to the agent for every query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This project provides reflective memory using semantic search powered by BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, utilizing edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by using local BM25 ranking for tool selection. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: A Git-backed context layer that supports Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, and OpenCode as first-class agents. It employs a migration workflow to convert documents and chats into reviewable files, requiring manual approval for context proposals and integrations.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with built-in 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch through importance-weighted recall, BM25 keyword search, and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that features real, immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every memory operation and prefetch action performed by the agent.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and handle x402 payments using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys, requiring only a few lines of TypeScript code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations to facilitate capability routing. It provides five native tools for artifact retrieval and uses session hooks to deliver concise system-prompt hints to the agent.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-session and cross-agent continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected instances. It utilizes native lifecycle hooks for session-end snapshots and a local SQLite layer for caching and write outbox reliability.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes Agent. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin offers private local code memory for repositories, supporting semantic search and grounded Q&A via a local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for indexing and file reads.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory solution that defaults to AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This project offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve agent state.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop that identifies stale information and contradictions within agent memory using specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators. It generates evidence-cited JSON diffs from plain markdown files, allowing users to track and revert changes through a local git repository.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning while adhering to TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It functions as a software development methodology that integrates with multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes Agent to generate web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts via a dedicated CLI. It supports native agent runtimes through the DeepSeek Harness and exports designs to formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. The skills are compatible with over 26 AI platforms to bolster security-specific capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It features an optional MCP server and supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layout changes.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill provides a master router for delegated permissions and x402 payments. It integrates verification and dispute resolution layers to facilitate secure natural-language mandates and escrow.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Compatible with Hermes and Claude Code, this project audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns. It offers professional, technical, and casual voice profiles across detect-only, rewrite, and edit-in-place modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and quality improvement to unify libraries across devices and team members. It integrates with Hermes, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs to allow skills to evolve collectively in the background.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within a project's documentation folder to support persistent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: A collection of 1,176 markdown-based skills covering 35 professions that run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring accounts or telemetry. These professional skills are designed for immediate use and include ready-to-paste exports for various assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, providing slash commands for managing the resulting library.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries via Git and S3 sources for Pydantic AI. It enhances agent safety by including sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host system while providing tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files from documentation and automatically synchronizes source file edits back to the original literate document.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow skill converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures output quality by utilizing a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro coordinates agent teams through the SLP cooperative-agent protocol and a mechanism kernel for SQLite storage. It distributes prompt-first working methods as Markdown recipes and skills, facilitating structured memory and event logging.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models, allowing agents to effectively train their own successors.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource offers a registry of Portuguese-language skills and guides for VPS deployment and MCP integration. It supports flexible skill installation through a CLI tap or raw URLs to assist Brazilian Hermes Agent users.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports specific integrations like CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, and is installable via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX image and video generation capabilities, including a specialized video suite with eight distinct skills. The project supports BFL API integration for polling and webhooks alongside specific prompting guidelines.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates verified instruction files from code repositories and documentation, mapping instructions to specific source lines or URLs. It automates the entire lifecycle of skill creation, including briefing, testing, and exporting compliant skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first Rust binary that uses a four-verb language to execute workflows with hash-chained records for tamper-evident verification. It prioritizes security and transparency by performing static audits of costs and permissions before execution.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the use of reusable AI skills through a Python client and a CLI with recursive dependency resolution. It uniquely incorporates commerce features by supporting skill transactions using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time progress and decision tracking. It ensures reliability during long-running operations through built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification, this hub facilitates community skill browsing and one-click installations. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer retrieval system that utilizes hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By optimizing skill selection, it reduces token usage and supports graceful degradation if specific dependencies are missing.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client uses a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token consumption during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental metadata retrieval.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to allow Hermes to drive scheduling and system design. It stores all data in a local SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This adversarial code review skill uses three parallel subagents to identify bugs and edge cases without modifying the source code. It combines deterministic scans from tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings triaged in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across various interfaces, including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, while supporting 97 languages. It is designed to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite based on five quality dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs a multi-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition to ensure evidence-based verification for Hermes. It includes a Python-based goal engine for persistent state management and causal debugging.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory equips Hermes with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards to address real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common skill directories.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection provides production-tested skills for session tracking, worktree recovery, and PR orchestration across multiple AI coding environments. It installs as drop-in markdown files and includes a bundled installer for managing updates and drift checks.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent, tracking token costs, session history, and skill analytics without outbound telemetry. It enforces strict read-only data access and supports optional incident alerting via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to generate reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by creating vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It optimizes output files for sizes under 8 MB and supports terminal interfaces, web apps, and libraries.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify skill gaps and propose updates. It gates changes behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files while monitoring official specifications to detect field drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compliant with runtime-specific profiles.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This project provides skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment for agentskills.io compliant clients. It includes an MCP server for browser-based OAuth authentication and supports workspace Postgres and scheduling.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos, performing OCR via macOS Vision, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It is designed for e-commerce workflows, converting video content into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and supports OpenClaw and Hermes Agent.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin facilitates earning or paying USDC on the Base network for support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for listing bounties and buying context, with payments distributed automatically upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills via a hosted MCP server. It enables agents to access structured web data across 31 different platforms.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate structured Chinese news reports across multiple geographic scales, ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansions with user interests and incorporates quality gates to produce briefings that include core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to perform fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It features a research team that debates bullish and bearish perspectives and supports backtesting with SEC EDGAR integration and point-in-time data integrity.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. Users can manage multi-agent workflows through a Web UI, CLI, or MCP server, with support for local Node.js or Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution. It provides TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities and supports sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent from single instances to automated teams, this template utilizes a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms across 23+ LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts to manage agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This platform provides a centralized screen for supervising autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning. It requires human-in-the-loop verification for all agent-proposed task completions to ensure oversight.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the MCP and ACP protocols. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. Using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for execution, the system visualizes agent tasks and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered knowledge graph that pre-indexes codebases to minimize token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It automatically configures as an MCP server and maintains background synchronization to ensure Hermes Agent has immediate access to project context.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI utility tracks token consumption across various AI coding tools and provides a terminal-based UI alongside a 3D visualization dashboard. It allows Hermes Agent users to monitor their usage data and participate in public leaderboards or profiles.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting sensitive authentication headers. It exports session data into self-contained HTML viewers, facilitating the debugging of agent communications.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget monitors real-time token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and other CLI tools directly. It synchronizes data across multiple machines to provide historical breakdowns by project, device, and specific tool.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other markdown-supporting providers to streamline the UI development process.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer extends Hermes Agent by loading 36 skills and six specialized workflows into the environment. It utilizes a CTO loop to coordinate seven agent roles for automated deployment, health monitoring, and log observation.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This customization tool allows users to modify the Hermes terminal UI with custom banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art. It uses YAML-based configurations to apply diverse visual themes ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk aesthetics.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is designed for autonomous agent control and supports external MCP clients for browser automation. It features a supervisor sidebar that allows users to manage agent checkpoints, approvals, and conversation threads.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and identity registration with human-readable handles. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter validates AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts against HERM v1.1 scoring standards. It identifies schema mismatches and contradictory directions in JSON, YAML, and Markdown, exporting results in formats like SARIF and GitLab Code Quality.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This integration suite provides memory systems for various frameworks using a two-tier architecture of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms and coding environments, offering persistent memory capabilities for agent-based workflows.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, supported by an automated cross-platform installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing for project-local memories, tools, and instructions. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents based on the local configuration of the directory.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides an automated installation path for the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It enables zero-cost operations using free models and supports 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions users from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the conversion of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It detects performance drift using config-aware baselines and supports both zero-token passive analysis and active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local runtime by default, this project focuses on deterministic operations that require explicit approval for external writes and consequential actions. It includes specific contracts for managing opportunities and offer-previews to help users generate value through the agent.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This project adds a fully local, voice-enabled interface to Hermes Agent featuring wake-word activation and adaptive turn-taking. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, operating entirely offline without the need for API keys or accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for managing agent information. It includes a built-in circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages while providing tools to search, add, and delete memory entries.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager supports Windows, macOS, and Linux for handling Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI. It streamlines the user experience by enabling one-click switching between different API providers and managing their respective configurations.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that facilitates autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access for Hermes Agent and other CLIs. It features built-in assistants for generating editable office documents and supports 24/7 unattended automation via cron and remote access.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web interface provides 1:1 parity with Hermes CLI features for use on web browsers and mobile devices. Built with Python and vanilla JS, it utilizes a three-panel layout to organize chat, sessions, and workspace browsing.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app offers guided installation with dependency resolution for Hermes Agent across multiple AI providers like OpenAI and Anthropic. The GUI includes dedicated modules for chat, session management, memory, and tool configuration.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a web dashboard that manages Hermes Agent sessions, scheduled jobs, and usage analytics across ten platforms including Telegram and Discord. It supports visual workflows that incorporate schedules and human approval gates for task execution.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex operations. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser and PTY terminal alongside a memory browser and MCP catalog.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and fourteen other built-in agents as a desktop or self-hosted app. It offers native iOS and Android clients for remote access and supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for real-time session data. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop app features a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat and memory management tasks.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser tabs to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes for site-aware drafting. It features multi-agent switching and opt-in browser control with session-synced chat histories.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app designed to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent via a hermes-webui server. It provides mobile management for server file systems and tasks, featuring real-time chat streaming with tool-call and thinking details.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency while providing a live view for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It includes a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that allows users to search prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across local agent histories. It builds a local search index to track per-session token burn and estimated API costs without uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically features an approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports managing profiles, skills, and toolsets while providing a kanban board for agentic work and task management.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a 10-page mobile-first UI with terminal chat and file attachment support. It utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to support background spawning of up to five concurrent agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring installation or admin rights. It includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI, supported by a built-in workflow engine for multi-step pipelines.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and chat for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes an integrated file browser, task tracking dashboard, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, offering real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards within a chat-first interface. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
